The '''Internal Security Police''' force was established to provide [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] duties for the [[New Regime]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]], prior to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Because Brigia was an impoverished world, the ISP brandished [[Slugthrower/Legends|solid-projectile]] weapons and were adorned with secondhand [[uniform]]s that were a poor fit for their thin, [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] body types.
